teaser.en: A wild grape vine of the coastal forest edge, climbing by tendrils and hanging with dark berries.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu mwitu wa pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, unaopanda kwa vikonyo na kuning'iniza matunda meusi.

summary.en: Mkororoi is a wild climber of the grape family, with three-part leaves and dark berries. Pakia records only its name.
summary.sw: Mkororoi ni mtambaa wa porini wa familia ya mizabibu, wenye majani ya vipande vitatu na matunda meusi. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu.

about.en: *Mkororoi* is a woody climber of the grape family. It climbs with tendrils, and its leaves are divided into three leaflets. The small greenish flowers are followed by round berries that ripen to dark purple or black, in loose bunches like small wild grapes.
about.sw: *Mkororoi* ni mtambaa wenye shina la mti wa familia ya mizabibu. Hupanda kwa vikonyo, na majani yake yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-kijani hufuatwa na matunda ya mviringo yanayoiva yakawa ya zambarau iliyokolea au meusi, katika vishada vilivyolegea kama zabibu ndogo za porini.

where.en: It grows on forest edges, in thickets and in riverine bush, and is widespread in eastern and southern Africa.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na katika vichaka vya kando ya mito, na umeenea mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika.

names.en: Pakia lists *mkororoi* with no meaning, no English name and no other language sharing it. Its relatives in the grape family on this coast include *mgongolo mlume* (*mwenjere*), *mbebeneka* and the *Cissus* climbers called *mdokadoka*.
names.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mkororoi* bila maana, bila jina la Kiingereza na bila lugha nyingine inayoshiriki jina hilo. Jamaa zake katika familia ya mizabibu katika pwani hii ni pamoja na *mgongolo mlume* (*mwenjere*), *mbebeneka* na mitambaa ya *Cissus* inayoitwa *mdokadoka*.

reason.sw: Cyphostemma (mwenjere), mtambaa wa familia ya mizabibu
Cissus sylvicola, mtambaa mwingine wa familia ya mizabibu
